name: CKEditor 5 Inline Quote
description: CKEditor 5 plugin adding a toolbar button that toggles an inline quotation (an HTML <q> element) around the selected text.
project_description: Adds a CKEditor 5 toolbar button that wraps the selected text in an inline quotation element (HTML <q>), for quoting a phrase inside a sentence rather than pulling a whole paragraph out as a block quote. It is a small, PHP-free module: a single CKEditor 5 plugin (inlineQuote.InlineQuote) is declared in ckeditor5_inline_quote.ckeditor5.yml with the toolbar item toggleInlineQuote (label 'Inline quote'), a prebuilt JS bundle (js/build/inlineQuote.js), a quote toolbar icon, and admin CSS. The plugin's .ckeditor5.yml lists elements: [<q>], so adding the button to a text format's toolbar also permits the <q> tag through that format's Limit allowed HTML tags filter. The shipped 1.1.0 code produces a plain <q>...</q> with no attributes. Installation: install as you would any contributed Drupal module, then add the Inline quote button to a CKEditor 5 text format's active toolbar.
